caution_findings.evidence_context: The article supports a U-251 MG intrinsic-apoptosis mechanism and high-dose membrane-disruption context; it does not prove broad cancer-line generality or ultrastructural membrane mechanism.
Figure S3 was image-only; it supports the negative autophagy interpretation reported in text, but no exact densitometry table is locally available.

extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from local XML/PDF/figure/supplement surfaces; no worker-5 expansion beyond source-supported claims.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: At high Dermaseptin-PS1 concentrations, U-251 MG loss of viability is associated with membrane disruption/necrosis rather than the low-dose apoptotic program.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Transmission electron microscopy was proposed by the authors as future confirmation; final record keeps this as source-supported membrane-disruption evidence, not a fully resolved ultrastructural mechanism.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=20:Dermaseptin-PS1 displayed antiproliferative activity in glioblastoma U-251 MG cells

mechanism_claims.claim_text: At lower concentration, Dermaseptin-PS1 induces apoptosis in U-251 MG cells, supported by caspase-3 activation, Annexin V/PI staining behavior, and caspase-inhibitor reversal.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The record follows the paper-specific U-251 MG model and does not generalize this mechanism to all cell lines.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=21:Dermaseptin-PS1 induced U-251 MG cell death at 10^-6 M via induction of apoptosis

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The low-concentration apoptotic response is assigned to intrinsic mitochondrial signaling, with extrinsic pathway markers not showing the same activation pattern.
direct_assay_types: Western blot for caspase 9/Apaf-1/Bcl-2 family/p53 pathway markers
mechanism_claims.limitations: The authors describe the mechanistic work as preliminary; the record preserves intrinsic-cascade assignment with that caution.
